detailCase1.2679: Small spaces often pose big challenges. It was no different with the design of a small studio for my client. The apartment is located in an old tenement house. Originally it consisted of a bathroom, a kitchen and a living room. Our main task was to separate a sleeping area and arrangement of space to be functional, comfortable and beautiful.
detailCase1.3681: the small bedroom has been separated from the living room, with windows facing north. The new bedroom has no windows, so instead of the TRADITIONAL wall, we have proposed a folded glass wall, which perfectly illuminates the room and can be folded if necessary, thus opening the space The bedroom has a double bed, a bedside table and a wardrobe. The wall is decorated with a beautiful Boudoir Navy WallArt wallpaper that goes all the way to the living room
detailCase1.3683: in the living room we have replaced the traditional window with a wallet window that illuminates the interior. The old wardrobe has found its use as a bookcase, while the armchair from the 1960s inherited from my grandparents fits perfectly into the style of the apartment. The bright sofa looks beautiful against the Boiduar navy wallpaper, and wooden accessories give the interior coziness.
detailCase1.3685: the kitchen is simple and elegant. Bright colors with the addition of wood and the green motif on the walls repeated throughout the apartment. Hanging cabinets are glazed, which gives the kitchen a light and elegant touch.

detailCase.2613: Large space and many possibilities. I present to you a house plan with separate zones for the kitchen, living room and dining room.
detailCase.3210: is the heart of the house. You spend most of the day here, prepare meals here - a place that should be not only unique, but also ergonomic and practical. In the place of the designed kitchen there was a small, impractical room - after demolishing walls and open space, we have a wonderful kitchen with custom-made furniture, a built-in refrigerator and an oven. Two pull-out cargo wardrobes are a perfect place for storage and the multitude of cabinets and drawers will satisfy the most demanding lady of the house. lighting, extractor hood and wooden accessories constitute a compositional whole. The kitchen is comfortable and beautiful at the same time
detailCase.3697: were an important element of interior design for my clients, which is why I decided to use a vertical garden in a coffee zone separated from the living room. The vertical garden is a unique element, referring to nature, but also cleverly placing a large collection of plants in one place. in the coffee area there is also a 3-seater honey sofa, two comfortable armchairs and a table. Next to the coffee corner, there is another space:
detailCase.3698: A bright, comfortable couch with a chaise longue, a comfortable armchair and a table - this is almost everything you need in a TV corner. I placed the TV on a wall covered with old recycled wood planks. Here also a reference to nature, but not only - wooden the cladding on the wall is also a way to mask the lighting and cables needed to connect the RTV equipment. The whole is complemented by accessories and fabrics that give the interior coziness and elegance.
